contexts.text: Are cast down of themselves...
All are not cast down into Hell in a moment... The Lord casts no one down into Hell, but everyone does so himself. AC 7877:4.
The Angels cast no one down...
Wherefore they cannot but cast themselves down headlong thence.
They cast themselves down thence...
On account of their aversion, they cast themselves down headlong into Hell.

Other. Spirits were then seen, who were cast down thence... This casting down was observed whenever angelic choirs came... They said of those who were cast down that they relate to the mucus of the nostrils...
They appear to themselves as devils... wherefore they cast themselves down headlong... AC 5057:end.
These Spirits were cast down into their own Hell.
They fear... that thus they will be cast down into Hell...
When the infernals try to attack goods, they are cast down deep into Hell...
Then the evil Genii and Spirits who had taken possession of the lower region of Heaven were cast down... The evil who were cast down were then deprived of external bonds...
The reason they are vastated before they are cast down into Hell...
It is according to order for one plague to follow another, and for the evil thus to be successively cast down into Hell...
So long as they have communication with Heaven by truths, they cannot be cast down into Hell...
Casting down into Hell does not come immediately from the Spirit who is in evil, but it comes from the Hells...
Hence it is that those who are in evil cast themselves deep down into Hell according to the quantity and quality of their evil...
In this chapter () the casting of them down into Hell is treated of, for casting down into Hell follows condemnation. With this state of casting down into Hell the case is this...
In this chapter () the Lord is celebrated, after... He had cast down into Hell the evil who were infesting the good in the other life...
Whenever the Hells make this attempt, many therein are cast down more deeply.
They then suffer hard things... wherefore they cast themselves down thence as if they were about to die, nor do they receive life until they are cast down out of Heaven.
To cast down into the earth of the army and of the stars () = to destroy the goods and truths of Heaven, and the Knowledges of good and truth themselves. AE 316:16.
They lie as it were in the death agony, wherefore they at once cast themselves down into Hell...
When they are in that profane worship the mountain opens into a cleft, and they are swallowed up, and are thus cast down into Hell.
The Lord casts down no one into Hell, but a Spirit does so himself. General article.
Therefore they are immediately cast down into that Hell as soon as they come into the World of Spirits.
As evil cannot but infest good... they are cast down into their places in Hell...
The casting down into Hell of those who have destroyed the Church, Signified.
Over a precipice, which then appears to them, they cast themselves down...

A strong Angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall Babylon be cast down () = that by the strong influx of the Lord out of Heaven, that religiosity, with all its adulterated truths of the Word, will be cast headlong into Hell.
Under Cast, see this reference.
I crawled to a precipice and cast myself down...
In the same proportion he casts down his mind from Heaven to earth...
God, through the Human... cast down the Hells, which had grown up even to the Heavens...
One of these great stars was yesterday, unless I am mistaken, cast down from the highest place, and with him a crowd then remaining of from five to six hundred, who adored him as an idol.

To cast down the horns of the gentiles which lifted up with the horn against the land of Judah (). The horns of the gentiles = the falsities of evil which have laid waste the Church, and which are to he dissipated in order that it may be restored.
To cast down the wretched and the needy () = to pervert those who are in ignorance of truth and good.
Strangers and the violent of the nations shall cut him off, and shall cast him down () = that falsities and the evils thence derived will destroy the Rational.
Under Cast forth, see these references. AE 739.
They are cast down through places of the rocks () = that they are let into their own falsities, and dwell in Hells according thereto.

When the Divine from the Lord flows in intensely, the goods with the evil are dissipated... thus the externals with them are closed, and the interiors opened, in which there are nothing but evils and falsities; whence come pain, anguish, and torment to them, on account of which they cast themselves down into Hells where there are the like evils and falsities. AE 419:10.
Ye shall be as an oak casting down the leaves () = that there is no longer any scientific truth.
To cast down their bars () = their principles of falsity, and falsities devastating truths.
To fall, and be cast down from Heaven into the earth = no longer to have a place in Heaven, but in Hell, thus to perish.
Thou God shalt cast them down into the well of the pit () = into Hell where there are destructive falsities of this kind.
(To cast down = to scatter.)
Thus with violence shall Babylon be cast down () = the total destruction of the doctrine.
